Lazy-loaded by the sheet-music worker (index.html: trxWorker) only when a recording is transcribed.
nmp.onnx = Basic Pitch "nmp" model by Spotify (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE-basic-pitch-model.txt), converted to ONNX from the
weights in ../basic-pitch/. Runtime: ONNX Runtime Web (MIT, LICENSE-onnxruntime-web.txt). ../basic-pitch/ (tfjs) stays as fallback.
